title: 第二十一章 纨绔挑衅展锋芒第二十二章 一拳惊座惹祸端
content_zh:
死寂！
宴会厅内落针可闻，只有赵元宝断断续续的惨嚎和那几个跟班痛苦的**在回荡。所有宾客都屏住了呼吸，目光在暴怒的城主赵天雄和那个依旧挺立、眼神冰冷的楚夜之间来回逡巡。空气仿佛凝固成了铅块，沉甸甸地压在每个人心头。
赵天雄那引气境巅峰的恐怖威压如同无形的潮水，虽然收敛了大半，但残留的余波依旧让靠近主位的宾客脸色发白，呼吸困难。他那张威严的脸上，怒意如同实质的火焰在燃烧，眼神死死锁定楚夜，仿佛要将他生吞活剥。
然而，楚夜敏锐地捕捉到了那一闪而逝的异常——威压的突兀收敛，以及赵天雄和楚山之间那极其隐晦、却又充满了贪婪和算计的眼神交流！这绝不是正常的反应！他们…在畏惧？还是在图谋？目标…是自己怀中那块来自黑风崖底、刚刚吸收了灰色符文的斑驳石壁碎片？
阴谋！一个针对他，或者说针对他身上秘密的陷阱！
楚夜的心沉到了冰点，后背道骨深处那团灰色印记也仿佛感应到了主人的警惕和杀意，微微悸动了一下，传递出一丝冰冷粘稠的恶意。他强压下翻腾的气血和道骨的刺痛，眼神锐利如刀，毫不退缩地与赵天雄对视，全身混沌灵力引而不发，如同绷紧的弓弦。
“伯…伯父！杀了他！杀了这个废物！他敢伤我！他敢在城主府撒野！”赵元宝抱着血流不止的手腕，涕泪横流，声音因为剧痛和愤怒而扭曲变形，充满了怨毒。
赵天雄深吸一口气，脸上怒容未消，声音却带上了一种刻意压制的“威严”和一丝不易察觉的异样：“楚夜！你当众行凶，证据确凿！本城主念你年少气盛，又是楚家子弟，给你一个自证的机会！”
自证？
楚夜心头冷笑，果然还有后手！
赵天雄目光转向身边一个身穿锦袍、面容倨傲的年轻人。此人气息沉凝，眼神锐利，带着一股世家子弟的优越感，正是赵元宝的堂兄，赵家年轻一代的佼佼者，赵元龙！修为已达引气境四层巅峰！
“元龙！”赵天雄声音低沉，“你堂弟受辱，我赵家颜面受损！你身为兄长，当维护家族尊严！去！与楚夜上擂台！生死不论！你若胜了，他伤人之罪，本城主既往不咎！他若胜了…”赵天雄顿了一下，眼神深处闪过一丝诡异的光芒，“本城主便承认他非‘废体’，今日之事一笔勾销！并赐他‘蕴灵丹’三枚，助其修行！”
哗——！
大厅内瞬间一片哗然！
生死不论的擂台战！这哪里是自证？分明是要借赵元龙之手，在“公平”的幌子下，光明正大地废掉甚至杀掉楚夜！赵元龙引气境四层巅峰，在黑岩城年轻一辈中都是好手！而楚夜，三天前还是个测灵珠下毫无反应的“废体”！就算刚才他展露了一手精妙的灵力操控，但在绝对的实力差距面前…这根本就是一场谋杀！
更耐人寻味的是赵天雄的后半句——承认非废体？一笔勾销？赐予珍贵的三枚蕴灵丹？这条件看似优厚，却更像是一个诱饵！一个在楚夜“侥幸”获胜后，将他推上风口浪尖、甚至可能引来更多觊觎和麻烦的诱饵！他赵天雄，绝不可能如此好心！
所有人的目光都聚焦在楚夜身上。同情、怜悯、幸灾乐祸、等着看好戏…
“楚夜！你敢不敢接？！”赵元龙一步踏出，引气境四层巅峰的气息毫无保留地爆发开来！灵力波动形成一股无形的风压，吹得他衣袍猎猎作响！他眼神睥睨，带着居高临下的傲然和毫不掩饰的杀意，如同看一只待宰的羔羊。“若是不敢，现在就跪下，向我堂弟磕头赔罪，自断一臂！本少爷或可饶你一条贱命！”
赤裸裸的羞辱和逼迫！将楚夜彻底逼到了悬崖边上！不战，是屈辱的苟活，自断前程！战，则九死一生！
楚山坐在赵天雄旁边，端着酒杯，眼帘低垂，嘴角却勾起一丝微不可察的阴冷笑意。赵天雄这步棋，正合他意！无论楚夜是死在台上，还是“侥幸”获胜后成为众矢之的，对他楚山都是有利无害！他甚至巴不得楚夜死在台上，省得他再费手脚！

楚夜缓缓抬起头，苍白脸上没有任何表情，只有那双眼睛，冰冷得如同万载寒潭，深处却燃烧着压抑到极致的火焰。祠堂前的屈辱，废体之名的践踏，楚山的阴毒，老祖的漠然利用，那阴影枯爪的窥探，城主府的陷阱…所有积压的愤怒和不甘，在这一刻被彻底点燃！
他需要力量！需要证明！需要撕碎这加诸于身的枷锁！
“擂台？”楚夜的声音嘶哑而平静，却清晰地响彻在寂静的大厅，带着一种令人心悸的寒意，“正合我意。”
他目光如电，直射赵元龙，嘴角缓缓勾起一抹冰冷到极致的弧度，一字一句，如同冰锥刺骨：“生死不论？好！你的命…我收了！”
轰！
楚夜话音落下的瞬间，一股远比之前更加狂暴、更加冰冷的气息猛地从他身上爆发开来！引气境五层的混沌灵力毫无保留地汹涌而出！不再是引气四层时的模糊感应，而是清晰可辨的强大威压！如同沉睡的凶兽骤然苏醒！
强大的灵力波动形成肉眼可见的气旋，以楚夜为中心扩散开来！吹得他洗得发白的青衫猎猎作响！脚下的地面，坚硬的青石板竟发出细微的**，以他立足点为中心，蔓延开细密的裂纹！
“引气境…五层？！”
“不可能！三天前他还是废体！”
“这…这气息…好强！好霸道！”
“他隐藏了实力？！”
大厅内瞬间炸开了锅！惊呼声此起彼伏！无数道目光充满了震惊和难以置信！三天！仅仅三天！从测灵珠毫无反应的“废体”，到引气境五层？这简直是天方夜谭！赵天雄和楚山的瞳孔也是猛地一缩！尤其是楚山，浑浊的老眼中充满了惊疑和更深的阴鸷！这小畜生…在寒渊密室得到了什么？！
赵元龙脸上的倨傲瞬间僵住，被一股巨大的惊愕和…一丝不易察觉的慌乱取代！引气境五层？！这怎么可能？！他引以为傲的四层巅峰优势，瞬间荡然无存！甚至…被反超了？！
“装神弄鬼！”赵元龙强行压下心头的震惊，色厉内荏地怒吼一声，试图用声势掩盖内心的动摇，“就算你用了什么邪法强行提升，根基不稳，也是废物！看拳！”
他不敢再让楚夜蓄势，脚下猛地一蹬地面，身形如同离弦之箭，带着一股刚猛凶悍的气势，直扑楚夜！右拳紧握，引气境四层巅峰的土黄色灵力疯狂凝聚，拳风呼啸，隐隐带着山石滚落般的沉重威势，狠狠砸向楚夜的胸口！
“裂石拳！”
这是赵家有名的黄阶中级武技，势大力沉，专破防御！
拳未至，刚猛的拳风已经吹得楚夜额前碎发飞扬！
content_en:
Dead silence!
A pin drop could be heard in the banquet hall, only Zhao Yuanbao's intermittent screams and the painful vaginas of the few followers echoed. All the guests held their breath, their eyes darting back and forth between the furious city lord Zhao Tianxiong and Chu Ye who was still standing upright with cold eyes. The air seemed to have solidified into lead, weighing heavily on everyone's heart.
Zhao Tianxiong's terrifying pressure at the peak of his Qi-entraining realm was like an invisible tide. Although most of it had subsided, the remaining aftermath still made the guests near the main seat turn pale and have difficulty breathing. On his majestic face, anger was burning like a real flame, and his eyes were locked on Chu Ye, as if he wanted to eat him alive.
However, Chu Ye keenly captured the fleeting anomaly - the sudden restraint of pressure, and the extremely obscure eye contact between Zhao Tianxiong and Chu Shan, but full of greed and calculation! This is definitely not a normal reaction! Are they... afraid? Still plotting? The target... is the mottled stone wall fragment in his arms that comes from the bottom of the Black Wind Cliff and has just absorbed the gray runes?
conspiracy! A trap for him, or for his secrets!
Chu Ye's heart sank to the freezing point, and the gray mark deep in the bones of his back seemed to sense the owner's vigilance and murderous intent. It throbbed slightly, conveying a hint of cold and sticky malice. He suppressed the churning energy and blood and the stinging pain in his bones, his eyes were as sharp as knives, and he looked at Zhao Tianxiong without flinching. The chaotic spiritual energy in his body was not released, like a taut bowstring.
"Uncle...uncle! Kill him! Kill this loser! He dares to hurt me! He dares to run wild in the city lord's mansion!" Zhao Yuanbao held his bleeding wrist and burst into tears. His voice was distorted by severe pain and anger, and was full of resentment.
Zhao Tianxiong took a deep breath, the anger on his face remained, but his voice carried a deliberately suppressed "majesty" and a hint of strangeness: "Chu Ye! You committed the murder in public, the evidence is conclusive! This city lord thinks that you are young and energetic, and you are a child of the Chu family, so I will give you a chance to prove yourself!"
Self-certification?
Chu Ye sneered in his heart, he really had a back-up plan!
Zhao Tianxiong turned his eyes to a young man wearing a brocade robe and a haughty face next to him. This man has a calm aura, sharp eyes, and a sense of superiority as a child of a noble family. He is Zhao Yuanbao's cousin, the leader of the younger generation of the Zhao family, Zhao Yuanlong! The cultivation base has reached the peak of the fourth level of Qi-entraining realm!
"Yuanlong!" Zhao Tianxiong's voice was low, "Your cousin has been humiliated, and our Zhao family's face has been damaged! As the elder brother, you should safeguard the dignity of the family! Go! Go to the ring with Chu Ye! Life or death! If you win, his crime of hurting others will be punished by this city lord. Don't blame him! If he wins..." Zhao Tianxiong paused, a strange light flashed in his eyes, "The city lord will admit that he is not a 'wasted body', and will write off today's incident! And give him three 'Spirit Containing Pills' to help him practice!"
Wow——!
There was an uproar in the hall instantly!
A life-or-death arena battle! Where is this self-certification? It was clear that he wanted to use Zhao Yuanlong's hand to abolish or even kill Chu Ye in an honest and fair manner under the guise of "fairness"! Zhao Yuanlong is at the peak of the fourth level of the Qi Entrainment Realm and is a good player among the younger generation in Black Rock City! As for Chu Ye, three days ago he was still a "wasted body" that showed no reaction under the spirit-measuring orb! Even though he had demonstrated exquisite spiritual control just now, in the face of the absolute power gap... this was simply a murder!
What is even more intriguing is the second half of Zhao Tianxiong's sentence - admitting that the body is not a waste? Write it off? Give the precious three spirit-acquiring pills? This condition seems favorable, but it is more like a bait! A bait that would push Chu Ye to the forefront after his "lucky" victory, and might even attract more covetousness and trouble! There is no way he, Zhao Tianxiong, is so kind!
Everyone's eyes were focused on Chu Ye. Sympathy, pity, gloating, waiting to see a good show...
"Chu Ye! Do you dare to take it?!" Zhao Yuanlong stepped forward and reached the peak of the fourth level of Qi-inducing realm.The breath exploded without reservation! The fluctuations in spiritual power formed an invisible wind pressure, making his robes rustle! His eyes were stern, with condescending arrogance and undisguised murderous intent, like looking at a lamb waiting to be slaughtered. "If you don't dare, kneel down now, kowtow to my cousin to apologize, and cut off one of your arms! Perhaps I can spare your life!"
Naked humiliation and persecution! Pushing Chu Ye completely to the edge of the cliff! Not fighting means living in humiliation and ruining your future! Fighting means a narrow escape from death!
Chu Shan sat next to Zhao Tianxiong, holding a wine glass, his eyes lowered, but there was an imperceptible cold smile at the corner of his mouth. Zhao Tianxiong's move was exactly what he wanted! Regardless of whether Chu Ye dies on the stage or becomes the target of public criticism after winning by "lucky chance", it will be beneficial and harmless to him, Chu Shan! He even wished that Chu Ye would die on the stage to save him any more trouble!
Chu Ye slowly raised his head. There was no expression on his pale face, only his eyes, as cold as a ten thousand-year-old cold pool, but burning with extremely suppressed flames in their depths. The humiliation in front of the ancestral hall, the trampling on the name of the waste body, the insidiousness of Chushan, the indifferent use of the ancestors, the prying eyes of the shadow withered claws, the trap of the city lord's palace... all the accumulated anger and unwillingness were completely ignited at this moment!
He needs strength! Need proof! We need to tear apart this shackles imposed on us!
"The arena?" Chu Ye's voice was hoarse and calm, but it resounded clearly in the silent hall, with a chill that made people's hearts palpitate. "It's just what I want."
His eyes were like lightning, directed at Zhao Yuanlong, and the corners of his mouth slowly curved in an extremely cold arc, and every word was as sharp as an ice pick: "Life or death? Okay! Your life... I will take it!"
Boom!
The moment Chu Ye finished speaking, an aura that was far more violent and colder than before suddenly burst out from his body! The chaotic spiritual power at the fifth level of the Qi-entraining realm surges out without any reservation! It is no longer the vague feeling when entraining the fourth level of Qi, but the clearly discernible and powerful pressure! Like a sleeping beast suddenly awakening!
Powerful spiritual power fluctuations formed a cyclone visible to the naked eye, spreading with Chu Ye as the center! It made his white-washed green shirt rustle! On the ground under his feet, the hard bluestone swayed slightly, and fine cracks spread around his footing!
"Qi-entraining realm...the fifth level?!"
"Impossible! Three days ago he was still in disuse!"
"This...this aura...is so strong! So domineering!"
"He hides his strength?!"
The hall instantly exploded! Exclamations kept coming! Countless eyes were full of shock and disbelief! Three days! Only three days! From a "wasted body" with no response from the spirit-measuring beads, to the fifth level of the Qi-entraining realm? This is simply a fantasy! The pupils of Zhao Tianxiong and Chu Shan also shrank suddenly! Especially Chu Shan, whose muddy old eyes were full of surprise and deeper evil! What did this little beast...get in the Hanyuan Secret Chamber? !
The arrogance on Zhao Yuanlong's face froze for an instant, and was replaced by a huge shock and...a trace of imperceptible panic! The fifth level of Qi-entraining realm? ! How is this possible? ! The fourth-level peak advantage he was so proud of was gone in an instant! Even... overtaken? !
"Pretending to be a ghost!" Zhao Yuanlong suppressed the shock in his heart and roared angrily, trying to cover up his inner shake with force, "Even if you use some evil method to forcibly improve, if the foundation is not stable, you are still useless! Look at the boxing!"
He didn't dare to let Chu Ye gather any more momentum, and he kicked the ground with his feet. His body was like an arrow leaving the string, and he rushed towards Chu Ye with a fierce and fierce aura! The right fist was clenched, and the khaki spiritual power at the fourth level of the Qi Qi Realm was condensed crazily. The wind of the fist roared, with a faint and heavy power like rolling rocks, and hit Chu Ye's chest hard!
"Stone-splitting fist!"
This is the famous yellow-level intermediate martial skill of the Zhao family. It is powerful and heavy, specializing in breaking defenses!
Before the punch came, the fierce wind of the punch had already caused Chu Ye's hair to fly!
